Name: Blood to Water
Description:
Target Enemy Regiment:
• The Regiment suffers one Hit per success.
• If the Target Regiment is engaged with a [Court of Water]
Regiment it suffers an additional amount of Hits equal to its current Resolve Characteristic, including all Special Rules. If the Enemy Regiment does not have Resolve Characteristic it suffers 2 Additional Hits instead.

Name: Lammelar Flow
Description:
Target Friendly [Court of Water] Regiment, until the end of the Round:
• The Regiment gains the Aimed Shot Special Rule.

Name: Swirling Embrace
Description:
Target Friendly [Court of Water] Regiment, until the end of the Round:
• The Regiment gains the Untouchable Special Rule.

Name: Induced Hypoxia
Description:
Target Enemy Regiment, until the end of the Round:
• The Regiment must use the lowest unmodified Resolve Characteristic in the Regiment.

Name: Flowing Stride
Description:
3 Target Friendly [Court of Water] Regiment, until the end of the Round:
• The Regiment ignores the effects of Hindering Terrain

Name: Water to Blood
Description:
Target Friendly [Mortal] Regiment:
• The Regiment Heals 5 Wounds.
